verdict.rationale: SvelteKit is Svelte's first-party application framework, documented on svelte.dev and compared to Next/Nuxt, and the official `sv` CLI scaffolds SvelteKit projects. Community users confirm it routes by folder hierarchy and clearly separates server and client loading, though routing comes inside a full meta-framework rather than as a standalone library. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the routing API itself (route files, params, navigation), any standalone router option for plain Svelte apps, and stronger independent corroboration of the routing integration.
